# SCI-POINT ODQ-002 Scientific-Owner Approval

Record identity: `SCI-POINT-ODQ-002-APPROVAL-2026-09-02`

Scientific owner: Grant Wilson

Status: decided

## Approved Decision

The scientific owner approved the Stage A recommendation for
`SCI-POINT-ODQ-002`.

SCI-POINT v0.1 publishes measured source displacement in the exact declared
tangent-plane basis. It does not change sign from measurement to correction,
compose telescope user or paddle offsets, select supporting observations,
publish a pointing-correction record, interpolate a correction, or apply one
to another observation.

The named pointing-support producer owns any downstream cross-array
aggregation, measurement-to-correction sign convention, telescope-offset
composition, record selection, native-support definition, and correction-
record publication. The producer must retain exact SCI-POINT parentage,
measurement identity, basis, unit, method/version, participating arrays,
uncertainty state, and limitations. SCI-AST owns conforming interpretation and
application of the producer-selected correction record within its authorized
support.

## Non-Effects

This decision does not approve the recovered TolTECA arithmetic mean, sign
formula, user/paddle-offset formula, record-selection rule, support rule, or
interpolation method. It does not admit a numerical parent route, answer
ODQ-003 through ODQ-009, launch Stage B, change an algorithm, or establish
implementation conformity, validation, achieved performance, readiness, or
production state.
